hooks.command: input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"git commit'; then output=$(./gradlew compileDevDebugKotlin -q 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then safe=$(echo "$output" | head -20 | tr '"' '`' | tr '\n' ' '); printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Compilacion Kotlin fallida. Corrige los errores antes de commitear: %s"}' "$safe"; exit 0; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Verificando compilacion Kotlin antes del commit...

hooks.command: input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"git commit'; then staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- '*.kt' 2>/dev/null | head -50); if [ -n "$staged" ]; then violations=$(echo "$staged" | xargs grep -l 'Log\.d\|Log\.v\|println(' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$violations" ]; then files=$(echo "$violations" | tr '\n' ' '); printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Debug logging (Log.d/println) found in staged files: %s Remove before committing."}' "$files"; exit 0; fi; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Buscando logs de debug en archivos staged...
